policy: User direction: if it is the only available research endpoint with no verified replacement, treat it as canonical. Canonical selection is separate from provider lifecycle, release identity, row access and sample restrictions. Existing retired and superseded exclusions are not changed. Aliases inherit root decisions.
counterparts_note: Counterparts are reviewed related endpoints, including denied delivery copies, format alternatives and distinct related samples; listing them does not claim accessibility, identical population or interchangeability. Reasons specify the selection.

decisions.name: crsp_a_stock.stock_qvards
decisions.reason: Do not promote this undocumented query-variable helper to a research dataset merely because it is the available copy. Its combined legacy event-variable layout does not establish a standalone research product. Use documented CIZ stock and event tables for those research concepts.

decisions.name: crspsamp_all.ccm_qvards
decisions.reason: Internal web-query variable helper, not a research dataset: the production counterpart is explicitly commented "Dummy data set for web query QVARDS use only". The sample layout contains combined lookup variables and lacks dated research-link intervals. Sole availability does not establish research content.

decisions.name: crspsamp_all.ccmlinktable_trial
decisions.reason: Canonical restricted CCM sample linktable with usedflag; production CCM delivery access is denied. The sample link-history table lacks usedflag and is not established as an interchangeable population. Retain sample/trial scope; current release and observation coverage remain unresolved.

decisions.name: crspsamp_all.ccmnames_trial
decisions.reason: Canonical restricted CCM trial company-header endpoint, including ticker and CUSIP. Production CCM delivery access is denied. The companion sample comphead omits those fields and its population is not established as identical. Retain sample/trial scope; current release and observation coverage remain unresolved.

decisions.name: crspsamp_all.ccmxpf_lnkhist
decisions.reason: Canonical restricted CCM sample link history with linkdt/linkenddt, linktype and linkprim; production CCM delivery access is denied. The trial linktable includes usedflag and is not established as the identical history or population. Retain sample scope; current release and observation coverage remain unresolved.

decisions.name: crspsamp_all.comphead
decisions.reason: Canonical restricted CCM sample company-header endpoint. Production CCM delivery access is denied; no verified replacement for this sample population was established. The trial names table has a related expanded layout, but population equivalence is unverified. Retain sample scope; current release and observation coverage remain unresolved.
